clarity.notes: The first screen states the provisional conclusion, strongest contradiction, independent verdict/readiness axes, and one obvious verification action. Exact deployed proof is one interaction away.

hierarchy.notes: Verdict, blocker, action, and local answer path have distinct visual roles. Full graph complexity appears only in Claims; proof details appear only in Verify.

typography.notes: The sans/mono system distinguishes judgment from identity and receipt data. Fine rules and negative space replace cards and status pills.

motion.notes: Hover, selection, filtering, cluster collapse, and re-layout communicate graph state without decorative movement. Reduced-motion disables nonessential transitions and shimmer.

brand.notes: The restrained paper, graphite, vermilion, ruled dossier, and specimen code establish a coherent precision-review character without copying award UI styling.

remaining_gaps: The complete nine-stage production chain uses an explicitly labeled, keyboard-focusable horizontal viewport on narrow screens. The page no longer overflows and navigation no longer overlays the graph, but mobile Claims traversal and off-screen context still require owner validation.
The prototype uses synthetic fixed-position edges; a production renderer would calculate edge routing and collision avoidance.
Owner live review is still required to establish whether task time and review efficiency improve.
